# M3-0a: Carried sync and ynab cleanup

- Milestone: M3
- Branch / worktree: `t/M3-0a`, `../YNAB_AutoCategorizer.wt/M3-0a`
- Depends on: none
- Touches (exclusive while running): sync/, ynab/
- Plan refs: STATE M2-0 and M1-1 follow-ups
- YNAB access: none
- Deploy: no (smoke: none; ships in M3-17)

## Goal
`finbot sync --archived` no longer skips a plan whose check failed this run but whose stored verdict is true, and a test
guards against ids entering `ynab` operation strings.

## Scope
- `sync/mirror.go` `ScanDiscretionary`: include a failed plan in the returned list when the persisted row keeps
  `has_discretionary` true. A failed plan with no prior good verdict stays out.
- `ynab/`: the op strings in `client.go` are already fixed constants. Add a test that drives each client error path with
  a known transaction id and plan id and asserts neither appears in the error.

## Out of scope
- New YNAB writes (M3-7). Scheduler or `cmd/` changes.

## Acceptance (each must be demonstrably checked)
- [ ] Test: a plan that fails the scan with a stored true verdict is returned and still reported in `ScanError.Failed`.
- [ ] Test: a plan that fails with no stored verdict is not returned.
- [ ] Test: no client error contains the transaction id or plan id.
- [ ] go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./... green

## Result
- Status: DONE
- What changed:
  - `sync/mirror.go`: `ScanDiscretionary` builds its returned list from the verdicts read back after `ReplacePlanScans`, in
    list order, so a failed plan that kept a true verdict is included. A failed read-back returns an error, as a failed
    save does.
  - `sync/sync_test.go`: new `TestScanDiscretionary_FailedPlanFollowsStoredVerdict`; `TestScanDiscretionary_FailureKeepsLastGoodScan`
    now expects the failed plan to be returned.
  - `ynab/client_test.go`: new `TestClient_NoErrorPathLeaksIDs`, 6 failure modes across all 6 client methods (36 subtests).
- Acceptance:
  - Failed plan with stored true verdict is returned and in `ScanError.Failed`: pass, `go test ./sync -run TestScanDiscretionary_FailedPlanFollowsStoredVerdict`.
  - Failed plan with no stored verdict is not returned: pass, same test (`no-verdict`; also a stored false, `kept-false`).
  - No client error contains the transaction id or plan id: pass, `go test ./ynab -run TestClient_NoErrorPathLeaksIDs`.
    Mutation check: with `redact` made a no-op, 23 of the 36 subtests fail (restored afterwards).
  - `go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./...`: pass.
- Deviations from brief: none. Limit of the guard: no client method takes a transaction id yet, so that id can only reach
  an error through response or transport text, which is where the test injects it. An id added to an op string would be
  scrubbed by `redact` and would not fail this test unless redaction also missed it.
- Follow-ups for backlog: M3-7 (new YNAB writes) should add its write methods to the `calls` table in
  `TestClient_NoErrorPathLeaksIDs`.
- Docs follow-ups: none. The behavior `CLAUDE.md` describes for `sync --archived` still holds.
